topic: What is PD (pupillary distance) and why it matters for your glasses

youtube.title: What is PD on your glasses prescription? 👓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
PD: two letters on your prescription that matter a lot.
கண்ணாடி சீட்டில் உள்ள PD என்றால் என்ன? அது ஏன் முக்கியம்?

• PD = pupillary distance: the gap between the centres of your two pupils, in millimetres
• Each lens's optical centre must sit right in front of your pupil
• A wrong PD can cause eye strain, headaches or a 'pulling' feeling, more so with higher powers and progressives
• Ordering online? Use the PD from your latest eye test; children's PD changes as they grow

gmb.text: PD on your glasses prescription stands for pupillary distance: the gap between the centres of your two pupils, measured in millimetres. Every lens has an optical centre that must sit exactly in front of your pupil. If the PD is wrong, your eyes work harder, which can cause eye strain, headaches or a pulling feeling, especially with higher powers and progressive lenses. If you order glasses online, use the PD from your latest eye test, and remember that children's PD changes as they grow. The eye test in our store is free and includes PD measurement.
